parked_for: B1 verb patterns 2 — both shapes, different meaning (and start/begin both-OK). Do not put these back in a2_verb_patterns.
why: A2 Verb patterns 1 teaches two shapes: want to go · enjoy going. stop + -ing vs stop + to (quit vs pause in order to), try + -ing (experiment), and start taking both are B1 cards already: 'Both shapes, different meaning' and 'Both shapes, same meaning'. I stopped resting and continued is not a sentence a teacher has heard (E4). can't stand is on the B1 -ing list.

items.cz: Zastavil jsem se, abych si odpočinul.
items.explanation_cz: **stop** + **to** = zastavit se, a pak to udělat.

accepts: He started to work at nine.
items.explanation_cz: **start** bere **-ing** i **to**. Obě je v pořádku.

items.en: I can't stand waiting in queues.
accepts: I can't stand waiting in queues.
I cannot stand waiting in queues.
I can't stand waiting in lines.
